# Carl Anthony Interviewing Edo Cohen Ahead of AutoSens EU 2026


September 3, 2026


Ahead of AutoSens Europe 2026, Carl Anthony speaks with Edo Cohen, SVP Product at Valens Semiconductor, about the rapid adoption of MIPI A-PHY, including its selection by four OEMs for next-generation ADAS programs. Edo shares insights on EMC performance, interoperability, ecosystem growth, and how automotive sensing technologies are beginning to shape the emerging world of Physical AI and humanoid robotics.
